component.name: Imladris
component.summary: Native GTK4 and Libadwaita Markdown Editor

description.p: Imladris is a native Linux Markdown editor built with Vala, GTK4, Libadwaita, GtkSourceView 5, and WebKitGTK.

ul.li: Dual-engine architecture with GtkSourceView 5 editor and live WebKitGTK 6.0 rendering
Asynchronous background Markdown parsing via libcmark
Synchronized cursor and rendered preview scroll alignment
Floating contextual formatting popover on text selection
Multi-tab document management with unsaved changes safety prompts
